name: First Apartment Kit
description: A focused starting point for a newly equipped kitchen.
problemSolved: Covers core daily routines without filling a new kitchen with rarely used tools.
idealFor: First apartments, new homes, and anyone starting with an empty kitchen.
whyTogether: These tools cover simple breakfasts, drinks, sauces, and basic meal preparation while using little counter space.

faqs.question: Can I start with only the included products?
faqs.answer: Yes. The kit is designed as a useful foundation, not a complete appliance collection.

faqs.question: Do I need to buy everything at once?
faqs.answer: No. Each product can be chosen separately as your routines become clearer.

name: Everyday Cooking Kit
description: Reliable tools for uncomplicated meals at home.
problemSolved: Makes common weekday cooking tasks easier without requiring several single-purpose appliances.
idealFor: People building a steady home-cooking routine with limited preparation time.
whyTogether: One appliance handles hot meals and reheating while the other supports drinks, soups, and sauces.

faqs.question: What meals does this kit support?
faqs.answer: It supports simple roasted foods, reheated meals, smoothies, soups, and sauces.

faqs.question: Is it suitable for a small kitchen?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both products replace several narrower tools and store in a compact footprint.

name: Small Kitchen Organization Kit
description: A considered set for keeping everyday routines compact.
problemSolved: Reduces countertop crowding by prioritizing compact tools that cover regular routines.
idealFor: Smaller kitchens with limited cabinet and counter space.
whyTogether: Both products support frequent routines while remaining straightforward to clean and store.

faqs.question: How does this help with organization?
faqs.answer: It focuses the appliance list on compact tools with clear, repeatable uses.

faqs.question: Will these products fit every kitchen?
faqs.answer: Measure your available counter and cabinet space before choosing any appliance.

name: Simplified Kitchen Kit
description: Multi-purpose tools selected to earn their place.
problemSolved: Replaces several narrow-use appliances with a smaller set of versatile tools.
idealFor: People simplifying their kitchen or choosing fewer, more useful appliances.
whyTogether: Together they cover everyday hot meals, reheating, drinks, soups, and sauces.

faqs.question: What makes this a simplified kit?
faqs.answer: Every included product performs more than one useful task.

faqs.question: Should I add the optional product?
faqs.answer: Only if brewed coffee is already part of your regular routine.
